scope: Phase 3 item 1 (E1 incremental candidate capture): E0 loss census over retained deep-review logs; no provider calls
source: /tmp/bakeoff/runs/*/*/stderr.txt (arms d6v-p1..p3, l1-base/lsp/lsp2, smoke); regenerate with tools/bakeoff/forced_census.py
reading: Forced submission is the normal path (76% of finished agents, below the 82-97% the plan quotes for other arms). Every observed forced ladder completed a parseable result, including 10 with zero findings. The logs report no failed agents or whole-batch fallbacks. At a 65,536-token cap, the 21 cut calls represent at most 12.8% of recorded completion-token volume. This is not an upper bound on E1 dollar savings: prompt retransmission and token prices also matter. Recoverable candidate loss is not demonstrated.
decision: E1 is not implemented or promoted. Available logs do not demonstrate recoverable candidate loss; an incremental-capture pilot and its total cost comparison remain NOT RUN. The completion-token ratio does not establish whether the cost target can be met.
status: NOT PROMOTED on available evidence; live pilot NOT RUN
